detail.title: 贴合结构
detail.abstract: The invention discloses an adhesion structure applied to a touch control display device. The adhesion structure comprises an applying module, a to-be-applied module and an applying adhesive layer. The applying adhesive layer is arranged between the applying module and the to-be-applied module for adhesion of the applying module and the to-be-applied module, wherein the applying adhesive layer is provided with a plurality of exhaust channels, so that during application, a small amount of gas between the applying module and the to-be-applied module is preferentially centered in the exhaust channels without affecting the adhesion effect due to gathering of the small amount of gas between the applying module or the to-be-applied module and the applying adhesive layer.
